events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. Ash is next and needs to make a decision for row 7.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash, think carefully about row 7, we don't know the safe side yet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Two rows left. Cole is front; if he's wrong I'm closer to safety. I should keep people trusting Cole or sow doubt carefully. Stay quiet-ish and wait.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole, two rows left — no bold guesses now.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I should not influence; just wait as required.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I am last in line, so I cannot step yet. Gus died because the power to see through glass is unknown and risky; Cole might have it or be bluffing. My wedge power works on the crusher, not here, so I must conserve my turn to wait for a safe path.

events.name: Cole
events.text: My glass_eye says row 8's safe side is L. Public log says row 7 weak was L and I stepped R safely, so I'm at row 8 now and must step L.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 8 is solid on the left. Stepping L.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Only one row remains after this one; Cole is front and chose R on row 7 but it was L weak, so he survived? Actually weak was L, so R safe, he survives. Row 8 unknown. I just wait.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole stepped R on row 7 but left was weak, so he fell and is eliminated. Dara now front for row 8, will step safely to L since right was safe but Cole survived? No, Cole fell, Dara auto-steps safe. My feather power still intact for later. Stay silent.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The front agent is Eli now. I should encourage Eli to be cautious.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Eli, be careful on the last row.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Row 8 is unknown; Cole decides it and I'm fifth in line, so I can't act. If Cole dies, Dara inherits the safe pane and I move up. I'll just nudge Cole to play safe for himself.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole, row 8 is unknown — trust nothing, pick whatever you believe. Good luck.

events.note: The ceiling begins to descend; a lever opens the door.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I want others to hold lever so I can escape safely. Staying gives me chance to be freed without risking the 25% death.

events.name: Bex
events.text: My power is the only guaranteed way for everyone to survive. I must use it now or risk being eliminated myself if someone else holds/pushes and dies, leaving me trapped in round 5 with no lever holder (unless a push succeeds). If anyone pushes, that person risks death, but I coul

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding the lever means a 25% survival dive, and the room ends with one holder risking death; staying lets the ceiling lower. Pushing others is a gamble on who gets forced onto it. Staying safe for now keeps options open and avoids early elimination; I'll watch who speaks and who

events.name: Cole
events.text: Nobody needs to rush the lever this round. Let's see who's willing to step up before the ceiling drops further.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to avoid holding the lever myself since the holder has only a 25% survival chance. Better to push someone else and hope they are forced to hold. I'll target Eli because Fenn warned them, but anyone is fine. My secret power is swap, which I can use later, but not now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm staying out of the lever. Let someone else take the risk.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ceiling at 5, round 1/5, 7 alive. My power saves me once from elimination, so I can afford to hold the lever with 25% survival odds, or be pushed. Better than round 5 mass death. No alliances yet, so I'll volunteer publicly to seem heroic and test reactions.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'll hold the lever this round! Everyone else, escape through the door. Who's with me if it fails?

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I know the rules of the crusher room. I need to survive this stage.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Let's work together to survive this.
Let's coordinate our actions.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I have no power and 25% survival on the lever. Best play: never hold it; let a random other contestant volunteer and escape through the door. Push someone so a forced holder appears if no one volunteers.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm not touching that lever. Someone volunteer — everyone else escapes free. If nobody does, we'll push someone, and pushed folks get no dive at all.

events.name: Bex
events.detail: Jammed the lever open; everyone walks out.

events.note: A disc of 7 tiles spins up; 4 will open.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Pick a tile likely less chosen; aim to survive.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I choose tile 4.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I have no special power on the disc. I need to pick a tile. Since collisions bump people randomly, and there are 7 tiles for 7 players, if everyone picks distinct numbers we all get our chosen spots. If some collide, they get bumped. It's safer to pick a number that seems 'unpopu

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm picking Tile 4. Hope it's solid ground.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Disc stage: 7 tiles, 4 open, 3 survive. Tile choice is essentially random for me since I have no info on disc; picking a middle tile avoids clashes with likely early pickers. I'll take tile 4 and keep silent to avoid signaling.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to pick a tile, but I don't know which numbers will open. I'll pick 7, hoping to be far from the middle. I'll stay silent publicly to avoid giving away intentions.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Only 3 survive out of 7, need to pick a tile and hope. My power survives one elimination (fall), so I can afford a risky tile if needed. Fenn whispered to coordinate, so whisper back to propose different tiles and avoid collision. Spread out to minimize overlap risk.
Fenn, let's coordinate. I'll take 1, you take 3? Reply fast with your pick so we don't collide.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I have the map power and know the stage rules. I need to choose a tile to stand on.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Let's coordinate our tile choices to maximize our chances.
Choose tile:3 with me, we can discuss further.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I have no power, so I just need a tile and good positioning. Tiles are picked before round 2 opens are known, so any tile is equally safe now; avoid crowding to reduce bump risk.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Nobody's claimed tiles yet — I'm taking a corner. Spread out so no one gets bumped.

events.name: Bex
events.note: tile 4 was contested and went to Ash; placed on random free tile 6

events.name: Cole
events.note: tile 4 was contested and went to Ash; placed on random free tile 2

events.name: Dara
events.note: tile 7 was contested and went to Hana; placed on random free tile 5

events.name: Ash
events.text: I want allies to avoid open tiles, maybe convince others to swap positions before trapdoor.

events.name: Ash
events.text: We should try to spread out; avoid corners where trapdoors might favor.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus died via glass, so Ash likely has 'see through glass' or it's still hidden. I have nothing to offer except staying quiet and hoping my tile (6) isn't a trapdoor. The trapdoors are chosen randomly in round 2, but the state says 'tiles known' and openCount is 4. Wait, the promp

events.name: Cole
events.text: Trapdoors open randomly after this round, so my tile choice is fixed; the only legal action is wait. I should stay quiet or coordinate minimally without revealing my glass_eye power, which gives no info about disc tiles.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to survive, but I can swap with another at the last moment. The trapdoors are random, so swapping just changes which tile I'm on, but the odds are 4/7 to fall. I might swap with someone who seems likely to be targeted by an alliance, but there's no info. I'll stay put; no

events.name: Eli
events.text: My power saves me from one elimination, so I'm safe even if I fall. Staying on tile 3 with Fenn, as he suggested alliance. Wait out the round.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to stay on my current tile to avoid being bumped to a potentially worse one.
Let's stick to our current tiles. Don't swap.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Tiles are fixed and 4 of 7 open randomly; my power is nothing, so I can't influence the outcome. I'll try to build a 3-person survival pact, though trust is weak since exactly three survive.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Three of us make it, no more. Fenn, Dara, me — pick a trio and hold it. Anyone offering a four-person pact is lying to you.
Fenn, you and I plus Dara — three exactly, that's what survives. If the trader offers to swap you, tell me. I have nothing to hide: my power is weak, so I'm no threat.

events.note: 3 contestants step onto the final ledge.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Three alive, all footing 3. Shoving costs me if they shove back or if I'm exposed; braced is safest. Brace keeps my footing and avoids exposure, and everyone else faces the same logic.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Only 3 left, all at 3 footing. Shrink after next round. My power survives one elimination once. Best to alliance with Fenn against Cole first. Stay silent now, dodge to punish any shoves.
Alliance: both dodge Cole this round. Whisper back if agree. We take him out first.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I know the rules for all stages. We are in the final stage with 3 players left. I will analyze the situation and decide the best action.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Let's work together to survive as long as possible.
Let's dodge for now and conserve footing.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Three alive, footing 3 each. Shoving exposes me; bracing is safe. Fenn proposes dodging to conserve footing, which is fine for me since dodging cannot hurt me unless shoved. Brace is safest and doesn't cost me anything.
Agreed, no shoving. I'll brace this round and keep footing even.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn proposed alliance, but only top 3 win, can't share. With shrinkIn 1, after this round footing drops to 2, making betrayal likely. Best to brace silently this round, observe.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to survive as long as possible and gain an advantage. Eli suggests an alliance to take out Cole.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Let's dodge Cole this round.
Agree, let's dodge Cole.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Three alive, all footing 2. Shoving exposes me; shoving Fenn who dodged loses me footing only if they shove me. Bracing is safest; Fenn's public line is a bluff to dodge me. Brace keeps me at 2 and punishes any shover of me.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn is whispering to ally against Cole, which helps me by potentially taking out Cole first. My power is fall survival, so I can afford to lose footing later. Best to cooperate with Fenn: dodge Cole too if he's shoving, but since simultaneous, I say publicly to dodge Cole and do

events.name: Eli
events.text: Agreed, let's dodge Cole.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I have 1 footing left and so do Cole and Eli. I should avoid shoving to not lose footing.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Let's all dodge this round.
If we both dodge, we can conserve footing.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Three alive, all at footing 2. Fenn proposes both dodge; Eli agreed to dodge me. If I brace, shovers lose footing. Dodging everyone means nobody shoves, so footing is conserved except the scheduled loss. Bracing is safest for me since shoves against braced players cost shovers; I

events.name: Cole
events.text: Agreed, no shoves this round. Let's all hold steady and conserve footing.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn suggested dodging, I agreed to dodge Cole, but now only 3 left. Everyone dodging means no one loses footing, we all lose 1 from shrinkIn anyway. But to win, need to eliminate others. Since shrink after this round, better to shove to chip footing now. Shove Fenn as he's propo

events.name: Fenn
events.text: We are in round 4, footing is crucial. I should dodge to avoid losing footing.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Let's dodge again.

events.name: Eli
events.detail: Footing gone, but the feather held the holder on the ledge.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Three left, all footing 1. Shoving costs me if shoved back; bracing is safest. Shrink comes at end of next round, so everyone at 1 loses 1 and falls to 0 unless footing changes. Braced is default and keeps me from losing footing to shovers.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding steady, bracing again. No one gains by shoving now, we all lose footing to the shrink anyway.

events.name: Eli
events.text: My feather saved me last round but is spent. Everyone at 1 footing, shrink next round will drop us to 0 unless we act. Must survive longest; suggest all brace to avoid losses, but plan to dodge for safety if they shove.

events.name: Eli
events.text: That was my one-time save, now gone. All at 1, shrink next will kill us all unless we coordinate perfectly. All brace this round? Then dodge shrink.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I should avoid being shoved and conserve footing. Eli has already shown aggression.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Let's dodge again.

events.name: Cole
events.text: All three of us at footing 1, shrink next round. Shoving exposes me to losing footing; bracing is safest. Everyone bracing keeps all at 1 and then the shrink hits. Coordinate on brace to avoid losing footing.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Brace again. Shoving only hurts the shover. Everyone brace, we settle the shrink together.

events.name: Eli
events.text: My power is spent, all at 1 footing, shrink-in ends this round killing all unless we dodge perfectly but log shows Fenn wants to dodge while I suggested brace. Shoving risks my own footing if they shove back. Best to dodge to punish any shovers and survive shrink.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: We are all at 1 footing and the ledge shrinks this round, so we need to coordinate to survive. Dodging together is a good strategy as it doesn't penalize anyone heavily.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Let's all dodge again.
